about: The weekly AI showcase's briefs (tools/showcase.py): owner-style ideas, in the words a person types them, never the bench's subjects (tools/bench/ideas_briefs.py) and never a real set's name or a licensed character. Taken in turn, each once before any is made again. Add a brief under a new id; a brief's words, once made, stay as they were.

briefs.title: A lighthouse keeper's island
briefs.brief: A small rocky island with a red and white lighthouse, the keeper's cottage beside it with a vegetable patch, a rowing boat tied at a little wooden jetty and a seagull on the rail. About 32 by 32 studs.

briefs.title: A clockwork owl
briefs.brief: A clockwork owl perched on a branch, brass and dark brown, with big round eyes, folded wings you can tell would open, and a wind-up key in its back. Desk-sized, about 15 cm tall.

briefs.title: A night market stall
briefs.brief: A street-food stall at a night market: a striped awning, lanterns strung overhead, a counter with steaming pots and noodles, two stools, a cook and a customer. Compact, on a 16 by 16 base.

briefs.title: A mountain railway station
briefs.brief: A tiny alpine railway station on a slope: a platform with a bench and a clock, a little red train with two carriages, pine trees and snow on the roofs. Around 400 pieces.

briefs.title: A deep-sea research rover
briefs.brief: A yellow deep-sea research rover crawling over the sea bed on tracks, with a domed cockpit for one pilot, floodlights, a grabbing arm holding a sample jar, and a curious octopus nearby.

briefs.title: A beekeeper's garden
briefs.brief: A cottage garden with three beehives, flower beds in bloom, a beekeeper in a white suit holding a smoking can, a picket fence and a wheelbarrow. On a 32 by 16 base.

briefs.title: A sky pirates' airship
briefs.brief: A small airship for sky pirates: a wooden hull hanging under a patched balloon, propellers at the back, a crow's nest, a captain at the wheel and a treasure chest on deck. Around 600 pieces.

briefs.title: A hilltop observatory
briefs.brief: A hilltop observatory with a white dome that opens over a big telescope, a narrow stair up the side, an astronomer with a notebook and a starry sign by the door. About 24 by 24 studs.
